scripts.pack-repack: cd ../../packages/repack && pnpm build && pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../apps/tester-app-rspack1/.repack-pack && cd ../../apps/tester-app-rspack1 && mv .repack-pack/*.tgz callstack-repack.tgz && rmdir .repack-pack
scripts.pods: (cd ios && bundle install && (bundle exec pod install || bundle exec pod update))
scripts.bundle:android: react-native webpack-bundle --platform android --entry-file index.js --dev=false --bundle-output build/output/android/index.android.bundle --assets-dest build/output/android/res
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native webpack-bundle --platform ios --entry-file index.js --dev=false --bundle-output build/output/ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest build/output/ios
